content:
Priya (events): Heads-up — creating a single thread for the Satellite Series booth (Apr 25) + webinar tie-in. Need: booth ops, swag, speaking/submissions, launch posts + benchmark narrative, and lead routing.

Maya (marketing): Can we lock messaging pillars now? want to draft launch posts and a webinar blurb in this thread.

Jordan (growth): +1 on pillars. Proposed pillars: 1) predictable latency/cost 2) multi-env parity (hosted/dedicated/private) 3) easy evals/quality guardrails.

Ben (design): I have three swag mockups (stickers, hoodie, mini power-bank). Uploading comps in #design-assets shortly. Which item is highest priority?

Priya (events): Prioritize power-banks > hoodies > stickers. Shipping weight is killer though. Power-banks = more CTAs at demo table.

Sam (devrel): For the demo: need 1 demo laptop, 1 streaming box (for live transcript), two short prompt sets for the demo that show cost/latency tradeoffs. Can someone own prompt set?

Jordan (growth): I can draft two benchmark narratives: "90th-pctl latency vs cost curve" and "token cost delta with KV caching". Will write short callouts for the launch post and webinar slide.

Maya (marketing): For the launch post/stage post: short hero copy + 3 bullets. Draft: "Redwood Inference: consistent LLM inference across hosted, dedicated, and private — predictable latency, lower unit cost, and built-in quality checks. Join our webinar for a live demo." Thoughts?

Ben (design): That reads clean. I'll create a social image with the three bullets overlaid and a demo screenshot area.

Nora (sales): Lead flow: we need all lead scans to create a lead in SFDC with tags: event:satellite_series, source:booth, interest:dedicated/hosted/private. Slack alert in #sdr-ops with lead snippet. Who owns mapping?

Kai (ops): Recommend QR -> Typeform -> Zapier -> SFDC -> Slack. Use field mapping: email, company, interest, wants-demo. Zapier mapping snippet: 
```
Typeform.email -> SFDC.Email
Typeform.company -> SFDC.AccountName
Typeform.interest -> SFDC.RecordType
Typeform.demo_time -> SFDC.Activity
```
We'll include utm=event_satellite for all QR scans.

LogisticsBot: Shipping cutoff for power-banks to venue: 7 days before event (2024-04-18). Carrier SLA: 3-5 business days. Suggested ship date: 2024-04-12.

Priya (events): Volunteer roster: 2 AM shift, 2 PM shift. @Sam can you lead the AM demos? @Maya handle PM social/live post?

Sam (devrel): I can AM lead. Will prep 2 x 10-min demo scripts and a short FAQ doc for volunteers.

Maya (marketing): I'll schedule live social posts: 30m before booth opens and during peak. Also plan a webinar for May 2 as the post-event deep dive. Draft webinar outline: 1) Why inference matters for product teams, 2) Live demo + benchmarks, 3) Q&A and CTA to book Dedicated.

Jordan (growth): For webinar promotion: 1 push in product-newsletter, 2 tweets, 1 LinkedIn post, and add event to partner channels. I'll assemble the promo cadence.

Ben (design): Swag decisions: final mock for power-bank by EOD Friday. Need final logo lock (no gradients on power-bank).

Nora (sales): SLA on leads: 24 hours to assign in SFDC, 48 hours to do outreach. Will set up an assignment rule based on geography + interest.

Kai (ops): Can ops book the courier for demo kit? Need weight dims. Sam/Ben pls upload weight dim numbers to the thread.

Sam (devrel): Demo kit dims: 12x9x6, weight 9.2 lbs. Laptop + dongles + HDMI switch.

Priya (events): Speaking submissions: we have 1 accepted talk (15m) and 1 standby workshop (45m). Sam, you'll do the 15m demo; Jordan will do the workshop pitch if accepted.

Maya (marketing): Draft post for approval (short):
"We're bringing a live demo to Satellite Series — see how Redwood Inference delivers predictable latency and cost across deployments. Stop by Booth B4 or join our follow-up webinar on May 2. RSVP: <link>"

Jordan (growth): Quick A/B for post CTA: A) RSVP for webinar B) Book a demo slot. We can route different QR codes and tag sources.

Priya (events): Action items:
- Ben: final power-bank mock (due Fri)
- Kai: courier booking + zapier config (due Mon)
- Jordan: benchmark draft + webinar promo cadence (due Tue)
- Maya: final social copy + live post schedule (due Tue)
- Sam: demo scripts + volunteer FAQ (due Wed)
- Nora: SFDC assignment rules + SLA doc (due Wed)

Maya (marketing): thumbs up. I'll post a final checklist tomorrow morning and ping this channel. :thumbsup:

(LogisticsBot): Reminder scheduled: Ship power-banks by 2024-04-12.

Priya (events): Thanks team — closing thread once checklist posted.
